title: Muhammad Abduh's birth chart
metaDescription: Muhammad Abduh's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 11.0° Capricorn. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled fall in cardinal signs, the widest weighting the unknown hour leaves certain. The cardinal signs begin things; a chart weighted there treats every stall as a starting gun.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 11.0° Capricorn. That falls in the second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Venus in the classical scheme — an earth sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 6.5° Capricorn; Venus stands at 20.4° Aquarius; Mars stands at 16.9° Sagittarius. The tradition reads a mind that trusts the measured and the checked from Mercury, taste led by wit and proportion from Venus, drive that ignites on contact from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Venus and Jupiter: 1.2° from an exact opposition. An opposition is the tradition’s tug of war. Both ends are real, and the work is holding them at once rather than picking a winner. Behind it, Mars trine Uranus at 1.4°, and Venus sextile Uranus at 2.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These angles were checked through every hour of that civil day and survive throughout, which is why an unrecorded hour does not disturb them.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Mars, Jupiter, Uranus close a triangle of trines. Three trines close into a circuit the tradition calls a grand trine — ease so complete it can idle unnoticed for years. The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: No planet here is at home, exalted, in detriment, or in fall. That silence from the oldest layer of the scheme is itself a result, and it moves the weight of the reading onto the geometry.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 4 fire, 2 earth, 2 water, 1 air by element and 4 cardinal, 3 mutable, 2 fixed by modality. Jupiter and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Pisces into Aries during that day at the birthplace, travelling 13.5° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
